LESSON: HOLINESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.6: Holiness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Holiness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to avoid situations that lead to sin, • sing a song on holiness. Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,
2. acquire the value of holiness by keeping away from situations that lead to sin,
3. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit,
4. desire to lead holy lives free from sin. The learner is guided to: Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt, not please God, to avoid situations that lead to sin, Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. acquire the value of holiness by keeping away from situations that lead to sin,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire the value of holiness by keeping away from situations that lead to sin,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. desire to lead holy lives free from sin. The learner is guided to: Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt, not please God, to avoid situations that lead to sin, Why should you lead holy lives as young people?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to lead holy lives free from sin. The learner is guided to: Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt, not please God, to avoid situations that lead to sin, Why should you lead holy lives as young people?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Holiness.
2. Explain Holiness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in pairs, read 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt,
4. Show that you can: describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Holiness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how to avoid situations that lead to sin, • sing a song on holiness. Why should you lead holy lives as young people?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, read 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt,
2. In pairs, list sins that do not please God,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,
2. acquire the value of holiness by keeping away from situations that lead to sin,
3. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit,
4. desire to lead holy lives free from sin. The learner is guided to: Corinthians 6:19-20 and mention the lessons learnt, not please God, to avoid situations that lead to sin, Why should you lead holy lives as young people?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
